cards.card_text: If a woman gives birth to a son, she will be unclean for seven days, as she is during the days of her menstruation.
cards.verse_text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Say to the Israelites, ‘A woman who becomes pregnant and gives birth to a son will be unclean for seven days, as she is during the days of her menstruation.
cards.snippet: …unclean for seven days, as she is during the days of her menstruation.

cards.card_text: Then the woman is unclean for two weeks, as she is during her menstruation.
cards.verse_text: If, however, she gives birth to a daughter, the woman will be unclean for two weeks as she is during her menstruation.
cards.snippet: …woman will be unclean for two weeks as she is during her menstruation.

cards.card_text: When a woman has her flow of blood, she is unclean due to her menstruation, and friend, I'm a cookie stamper, so I'm reading it straight and keeping my mustache OUT of it.
cards.verse_text: When a woman has a discharge consisting of blood from her body, she will be unclean due to her menstruation for seven days, and anyone who touches her will be unclean until evening.
